title: About us - Multivac
content: ### MULTIVAC - Packaging and processing solutions designed and built for your success. Packaging machines & packaging technology, automation solutions & processing technology, labelling and inspection systems, portioning and slicing - and, since the takeover of the FRITSCH Group, bakery technology as well. For more than 60 years, MULTIVAC has been one of the leading manufacturers of packaging machines. Company headquarters - as well as the nucleus of the now global MULTIVAC Group - are located in Wolfertschwenden, Germany. 16 production sites, state-of-the-art Application Centers, best-in-class service and support, comprehensive advice and intelligent logistics ensure that all MULTIVAC solutions are successfully deployed worldwide. Founded in 1961 in a small garage in Böhen and now firmly rooted in the idyllic German region of Allgäu, our group of companies has quickly developed into a global player and a trusted provider of integrated solutions. sales and service companies are part of the MULTIVAC Group.

title: MULTIVAC Marks 50 Years In Business - Bakers Journal
content: # MULTIVAC marks 50 years in business. Since it was founded by Sepp Haggenmüller in 1961, MULTIVAC has developed into a full-range supplier of automated packaging solutions. Haggenmüller built the first MULTIVAC chamber machine in 1961. In 1966 and 1967, the first thermoforming machines followed, marking an international breakthrough for Haggenmüller and his partners. In the early nineties, the tray sealer was added to MULTIVAC’s packaging machine ranges, making it possible to seal pre-fabricated trays and tubs. In addition to packaging machines, handling solutions for loading and unloading as well as the separation of packets, quality inspection systems for detecting quality faults and foreign objects in the packs are now part of the machine manufacturer's portfolio. The MULTIVAC Group has more than 3,000 employees worldwide, including over 1,300 at its headquarters in Wolfertschwenden.
